transport.rate_limit: none documented; 60-day retention for daily files

parsing.notes: ZIP of iXBRL .html (+ some .xml). Filename Prod223_<run>_<companynumber>_<madeupto>.html. Parse ix:nonFraction / ix:nonNumeric by @name (FRC taxonomy: core:/bus:). Handle multiple contexts (current/prior, instant/duration) via contextRef + sign/scale (decimals/scale attrs). Coverage = e-filed only (~60-75%).

mapping_rules.financials: Per filing (made_up_to year): turnover=core:TurnoverRevenue, profit_loss=core:ProfitLoss, fixed_assets=core:FixedAssets, cash=core:CashBankOnHand, net_current_assets=core:NetCurrentAssetsLiabilities, net_assets=core:NetAssetsLiabilities, equity=core:Equity. currency=GBP.

fixture_requirements: FULL/SMALL accounts with turnover + net assets (e.g. 00009604)

live_test_plan.smoke: Open one daily zip; parse one iXBRL; assert company number + at least one core: figure.
live_test_plan.full: Daily harvest (within the 60-day window) + monthly backfill; extract facts to NDJSON keyed on company number + period.

blockers: Coverage = electronically-filed accounts only (~60-75%); paper/scanned PDFs excluded.
iXBRL multi-context parsing required to pick the right period/sign/scale.
